coordinated_activities.activity: Morning wash: shower, brush teeth, use toilet
Prepare and eat breakfast using kettle and toaster
Change into work clothes, check phone for shift messages, pack bag
Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
Working day shift as a health care professional: patient care, ward rounds, charting and handover
Wash up and change out of work clothes
Cook and eat dinner using oven and microwave (deliberately avoiding the induction cooker during the 5pm-8pm grid peak request)
Load the washing machine and start a laundry cycle
Watch TV and relax on the sofa
Transfer laundry to the clothes dryer and start drying
Use the computer to check rosters and messages, then watch TV
Night routine: brush teeth and wash face
Wind down with phone, then sleep
